steps.content: [WhiteSands - Daytime]

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Korryn, Korryn, Korryn, why isn't she back yet...
Maggie mutters as she constantly looks back.
After Korryn left, Hella took over the wheel. No pursuers are left in sight. The Tuco folks have successfully shaken off the desert bandits, but their compatriot hasn't returned.
Timmy sits in the corner, hugging his knees and weeping silently. Silence spreads like a plague among the injured townsfolk... until someone speaks up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She'll be back. I believe in her.
Miraculously, Hella's voice doesn't tremble at all.
Calm, rational, and determined... her words are no longer hesitant, just like the person in her memories.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's Korryn, after all. You guys know her better than I do. No one is better at getting in and out of danger than her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't worry. She's probably already kicked those desert bandits' butts, and will pop up any second now...!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.content: You're right. We have to trust her.
Mira walks over to Hella and helps her steer. Little Timmy wipes his tears and joins Maggie in looking out from the back of the ship.
The sand ship speeds along, and the destination is in sight. Just as Korryn said, everything is under control, and everyone will be fine.
Suddenly, a glimmer flashes through the sand.
Hella doesn't miss this fleeting flash.
...How could I forget? There's more than one "pursuer."
She clenches her fist tightly, then relaxes it again. She has made up her mind.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know what to do now. Keep my guard up, notice every suspicious detail, and then bravely...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Turns out... I really did learn something from that liar...
The small sand ship, exhausted from many hours of travel, gradually stalls and comes to a stop on the sand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You guys go ahead first.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There might be other enemies nearby. The sand ship is too loud. If the Hypercubes get snatched, it's all over.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Actually... I'm still a bit worried about Korryn. Before she jumped off, she whispered to me that if I got you all to safety, it would be best to go back and pick her up.
Mira looks at the injured townsfolk. She seems to notice something too, but doesn't voice any objections.
After a moment of silence, she leads the way by jumping off the sand ship, and calls the other townsfolk to disembark.

The townsfolk don cloaks the same color as the sand, blending in with the desert. Before leaving, Mira turns to glance at the girl on the ship one last time. Hella waves casually, restarting the engine.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: After you get the Hypercubes, find a safe place to hide. Don't let anyone else find you! I'll be back as soon as I pick her up!
Hella turns and heads off in the other direction.
[WhiteSands - Daytime]
A sand ship glides slowly, almost leisurely, through WhiteSands.
After finally stopping, it honks twice, then honks twice again.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey... hey hey hey!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: With a puzzled frown, you step closer.
The sand shifts, revealing a squad hidden beneath.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Long time no see, Miss Sinner. Where are your Tuco friends?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What Tuco friends? I don't have any friends from Tuco!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I've been with you guys from the start, don't you remember? We're partners, after all.
Scotch pretends to suddenly come to a realization.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Oh then I'm relieved. I thought you were deliberately acting as bait.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Let's go, back to the ship... We need to have a good talk.
